revisedProjectTitle.en: Uncertainty-Aware Abstention for Smartphone-Based Remote PPG Under Motion and Illumination Variations: A Quality-Gated Research Prototype, Signal Reliability, Selective Prediction, and On-Device Processing Architecture
revisedProjectTitle.ar: الامتناع الواعي بعدم اليقين لتقدير النبض البصري عن بُعد (rPPG) عبر الهاتف الذكي تحت تغيرات الحركة والإضاءة: نموذج بحثي أولي محكوم بجودة الإشارة، التنبؤ الانتقائي، ومعمارية المعالجة المحلية

medicalDisclaimer.en: RESEARCH PROTOTYPE ONLY — NOT FOR MEDICAL DIAGNOSIS OR TREATMENT DECISIONS. Clinical validation has not yet been conducted.
medicalDisclaimer.ar: نموذج بحثي أولي فقط — غير مخصص للتشخيص الطبي أو اتخاذ القرارات العلاجية. لم يُجرَ أي تحقق سريري على البشر حتى الآن.

keyCorrectionsApplied: Scoped V1 contribution to Quality-Gated Smartphone rPPG, HR estimation, signal quality evaluation, and Selective Abstention.
Added permanent 'SIMULATED DATA — NOT A CLINICAL MEASUREMENT' badges and mathematical synthetic generator equations above all 4 interactive simulators.
Replaced 'CLSI EP17-A2' pairing with Hb MAE / Bilirubin AUC; documented CLSI EP17-A2 (LoB/LoD/LoQ) vs. CLSI EP09 (method comparison) and CLSI EP05/EP15 (precision).
Separated IEEE Std 1708-2025 (wearable cuffless BP) from ISO 81060-2:2018 (intermittent automated cuff sphygmomanometers) and distinguished PTT from PAT (PEP).
Removed Clarke Error Grid from PCG + Wear OS evaluation (Clarke Error Grid is exclusively for blood glucose).
Reframed 20 kHz acoustic sensing as an exploratory chest-motion phase experiment and cited AASM PSG/HSAT guidelines for clinical OSA/AHI.
Removed HbA1c from V1 capabilities into Exploratory Future Hypotheses.

Defined exact SQI spectral bandwidth (f0 ± 0.15 Hz, 2f0 ± 0.15 Hz on 3.0s Hanning window) and Laplacian focus ROI (8-bit [0..255] grayscale 128x128 patch) and labeled 0.65 and 110.0 as heuristic baseline thresholds requiring validation-split tuning.
Removed live global mortality ticker and 'Lives Saved' framing; replaced with documented Epidemiological Provenance Table and non-additive Theoretical Target Screening Reach.
Separated MIMIC-IV v3.1 EHR from MIMIC-IV Waveform v0.1.0, clarified neither contains facial video (PURE and UBFC-rPPG do), and marked FA-HISTS dataset as a planned protocol requiring IRB approval.
Added static_assert(alignof(BiophysicalFramePacket) == 64), offsetof checks, non-causal filtfilt buffering notes, and renamed NtpClockSynchronizer to LocalFourTimestampClockOffsetEstimator.

Separated Claude Team Plan for Scientists ($0 Standard / $15 Premium up to 25 seats for 12m) from Anthropic AI for Science API Credits (up to $20,000 for 6m) and replaced unreleased model names in the budget calculator with verified public API pricing.
